_why_locale_catalogs_not_all_caps: The real archive's own paths (7z against BoingBag39-2-turkce.lha) are
exactly as measured. `to` is written mixed-case, `Locale/Catalogs`,
matching the AmigaDOS convention every other component in every shipped
recipe already uses for a destination it writes (`Locale/Countries`,
`Locale/Languages`, `Locale/Help` in the 3.2 recipe) — never the all-caps
spelling a Joliet-less disc's own Primary tree happens to force on a
`from`. AmigaDOS resolves a path case-insensitively, so this cannot
collide with anything; nothing in the shipped AmigaOS 3.9 recipe writes a
`Locale` drawer of its own yet (see that recipe's own `_why_no_T` note),
so there is no existing sibling spelling on the built tree to match
either way here — `Locale/Catalogs` is chosen for consistency with the
3.2 recipe's own Locale destinations and with AmigaDOS convention
generally, not because anything already on disk demands it.
